versions.changelog:
v1.2.1: 修复 SkillSpector 全部 8 个 finding（零功能改动，仅加警告/guardrails）

【Lp3】加 metadata.openclaw permissions 声明
【Missing User Warnings ×6】顶部加数据外发/凭据安全提醒; Quick Start 加 env 泄露提醒; Provider Guide 加授权码安全提醒; Privacy 节补充 env 暴露说明; integrations.md 顶部总提醒 + 发票/合同/简历工作流各加 guardrails
【Session Persistence】credentials 文件已标注 chmod 600 且多处提醒不存明文

v1.2.0: Security hardening - removed auto crontab modification, removed plaintext credential storage, added forward support, body search, bilingual output, manual-only scheduler setup. All security scan concerns addressed.

v1.1.0: Fixed critical bugs (broken scheduler, missing forward feature), added forwarding support, body search, bilingual output, international provider docs, documented --receipt/--importance/--folder options, security review clean (stdlib only)
Initial release: IMAP/SMTP email client supporting 12+ providers, send/receive/search/schedule emails, HTML templates, attachments, document integration
